    m.loser_id AS loser_id,
    w2.name AS loser_name,
    m.title_id AS title_id,
    b.name AS belt_name,
    m.duration AS duration,
    m.title_change AS title_change
  FROM Matches m
  LEFT JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON CAST(m.winner_id AS INTEGER) = w1.id
  LEFT JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON CAST(m.loser_id AS INTEGER) = w2.id
  LEFT JOIN Belts b ON CAST(m.title_id AS INTEGER) = b.id
),

  SELECT
    m.*,
    (length(duration) - length(replace(duration, ':', ''))) AS colon_count,
    CASE
      WHEN duration IS NULL OR trim(duration) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN (length(duration) - length(replace(duration, ':', ''))) = 1
        THEN (
          CAST(substr(duration, 1, instr(duration, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60
          + CAST(substr(duration, instr(duration, ':')+1) AS INTEGER)
        )
      WHEN (length(duration) - length(replace(duration, ':', ''))) = 2
        THEN (
          CAST(substr(duration, 1, instr(duration, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 3600
          + CAST(
              substr(
                duration,
                instr(duration, ':')+1,
                instr(substr(duration, instr(duration, ':')+1), ':') - 1
              ) AS INTEGER
            ) * 60
          + CAST(
              substr(
                duration,
                instr(duration, ':') + 1 + instr(substr(duration, instr(duration, ':')+1), ':')
              ) AS INTEGER
            )
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS parsed_secs
  FROM matches_with_wrestler_names_and_belt m
  WHERE
    m.title_change = 0
    AND m.belt_name IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(m.belt_name) LIKE '%nxt%'
    AND m.duration IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(m.duration) <> ''
)

  pm.winner_name,
  pm.loser_name,
  pm.duration
FROM parsed_matches pm
WHERE
  pm.parsed_secs IS NOT NULL
  AND pm.parsed_secs = (
    SELECT MIN(parsed_secs) FROM parsed_matches WHERE parsed_secs IS NOT NULL
  )

The quintile should be determined by calculating how many students have grades greater than or equal to each student's grade, then dividing this ranking by the total number of students who completed English courses. The quintiles should be labeled as "First" (top 20%), "Second" (top 21-40%), "Third" (top 41-60%), "Fourth" (top 61-80%), and "Fifth" (bottom 20%). Please sort the results from highest performing quintile to lowest (First to Fifth).

WITH english_completed AS (
  SELECT
    ss.StudentID,
    st.StudLastName,
    ss.Grade
  FROM Student_Schedules ss
  JOIN Students st ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
  JOIN Classes c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
  JOIN Subjects subj ON subj.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
  JOIN Categories cat ON cat.CategoryID = subj.CategoryID

    AND cat.CategoryDescription = 'English'

    t.Minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN t.Milliseconds >= s.MinMilliseconds AND t.Milliseconds <= s.Mid1Milliseconds THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds >  s.Mid1Milliseconds AND t.Milliseconds <= s.Mid2Milliseconds THEN 'Medium'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds >  s.Mid2Milliseconds AND t.Milliseconds <= s.MaxMilliseconds THEN 'Long'
    END AS Category,
    ir.TrackRevenue
  FROM track_core t
  CROSS JOIN track_duration_stats s
  LEFT JOIN invoice_line_revenue_by_track ir USING (TrackId)
) sub
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY CASE Category WHEN 'Short' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Long' THEN 3 END

rows.question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH order_items_financials AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    order_item_id,
    product_id,
    seller_id,
    shipping_limit_date,
    price,
    freight_value,
    (COALESCE(price, 0.0) + COALESCE(freight_value, 0.0)) AS item_total_value
  FROM order_items
),
order_reviews_by_order AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    review_id,
    review_score,
    review_creation_date
  FROM order_reviews
  WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
),
product_catalog_with_translation AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
    ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
),
orders_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    CASE WHEN order_purchase_timestamp = '' THEN NULL ELSE order_purchase_timestamp END AS order_purchase_timestamp,
    CASE WHEN order_approved_at = '' THEN NULL ELSE order_approved_at END AS order_approved_at,
    CASE WHEN order_delivered_carrier_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE order_delivered_carrier_date END AS order_delivered_carrier_date,
    CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE order_delivered_customer_date END AS order_delivered_customer_date,
    CASE WHEN order_estimated_delivery_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE order_estimated_delivery_date END AS order_estimated_delivery_date
  FROM orders
),
order_items_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    oi.seller_id,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    oi.product_id,
    pcwt.product_category_name,
    pcwt.product_category_name_english,
    oi.price,
    oi.freight_value,
    oi.item_total_value,
    oi.shipping_limit_date
  FROM order_items_financials oi
  LEFT JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  LEFT JOIN product_catalog_with_translation pcwt ON oi.product_id = pcwt.product_id
),
-- per-seller totals
seller_totals AS (
  SELECT
    oie.seller_id,
    oie.seller_city,
    oie.seller_state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_quantity_sold,
    SUM(oie.price) AS total_sales_revenue
  FROM order_items_enriched oie
  JOIN orders_normalized o ON oie.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oie.seller_id, oie.seller_city, oie.seller_state
),
-- average review score per seller: aggregate reviews per order then average across distinct orders that include the seller
seller_avg_review AS (
  SELECT
    soi.seller_id,
    AVG(ord_rev.avg_review_score) AS average_review_score
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id FROM order_items_enriched
  ) soi
  JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM order_reviews_by_order
    GROUP BY order_id
  ) ord_rev ON soi.order_id = ord_rev.order_id
  GROUP BY soi.seller_id
),
-- average packing time in hours per seller: compute per distinct seller-order then average; exclude NULL timestamps
seller_avg_packing AS (
  SELECT
    soi.seller_id,
    AVG((julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) * 24.0) AS average_packing_time_hours
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id FROM order_items_enriched
  ) soi
  JOIN orders_normalized o ON soi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date <> ''
    AND o.order_approved_at <> ''
  GROUP BY soi.seller_id
),
-- top product category per seller by quantity sold (ties: any one). Use row_number to pick top.
seller_top_category AS (
  SELECT
    seller_id,
    product_category_name_english AS top_product_category_name_english
  FROM (
    SELECT
      oie.seller_id,
      oie.product_category_name_english,
      COUNT(*) AS qty,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oie.seller_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM order_items_enriched oie
    GROUP BY oie.seller_id, oie.product_category_name_english
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  st.seller_id,
  st.seller_city,
  st.seller_state,
  st.total_quantity_sold,
  st.total_sales_revenue,
  CASE WHEN st.total_quantity_sold > 0 THEN (st.total_sales_revenue / st.total_quantity_sold) ELSE NULL END AS average_item_price,
  sar.average_review_score,
  sap.average_packing_time_hours,
  stc.top_product_category_name_english
FROM seller_totals st
LEFT JOIN seller_avg_review sar ON st.seller_id = sar.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_avg_packing sap ON st.seller_id = sap.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_top_category stc ON st.seller_id = stc.seller_id
WHERE st.total_quantity_sold > 100
ORDER BY st.total_quantity_sold DESC
